name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix exploded +7.4% to ₩2,309,000 — a new closing high for the recovery — as the US–Iran peace deal was declared "now complete" with the Strait of Hormuz reopening. Global risk-on went into overdrive: the Nasdaq rose +2.38% and NVIDIA jumped ~2.8% to ~$211. SK Hynix, the supply-side twin of the NVIDIA trade, was up more than 6% in pre-market and extended the rally through the regular session. Bulls won decisively: with Iran risk cleared and the AI-memory supercycle intact, the stock's year-to-date advance is now an extraordinary ~241% and it sits within ~4.1% of its June 2 ATH.
long_pnl: +7.4% — the single best session of the recovery; three-day rebound from Wednesday's ₩2,048,000 low now totals ~+12.7%
short_pnl: −7.4% — a brutal squeeze; any short into a confirmed peace deal + Nasdaq +2.38% + NVDA +2.8% was run over

decision.rationale: Reaffirm BUY and raise conviction to HIGH. The macro overhang that drove the early-June panic is gone: the US–Iran deal is "now complete" and Hormuz is reopening, removing the geopolitical and FX risk that had nothing to do with the business. Risk-on is global — Nasdaq +2.38%, NVDA ~$211 (+~2.8%) — and as NVIDIA's primary advanced-HBM supplier, SK Hynix is directly geared to that strength. The fundamental case is the strongest in the company's history: ~70%+ HBM market share, ~20% secured HBM3E price hikes for 2026 to NVIDIA + ASIC customers (Google, AWS), record Q1 (₩52.6T revenue, +198% YoY, 72% operating margin), and a ~38-analyst PT near ₩2.52M (~9% above today's close, with the stock at a fresh recovery high). The only remaining gate is FOMC Wednesday June 17. With conviction high, the play is: hold core longs, but given the +7.4% one-day rip into the Fed, scale any NEW adds and keep some powder for a post-FOMC dip rather than chasing the print. Above the ₩2,407,000 ATH, the stock is in price discovery.

positioning.short_interest: Foreign-owned ~54% of float — heavy net foreign buying for a third straight session; pre-market bid +6% led the regular-session breakout
positioning.notable_flow: The de-risking that gutted SK Hynix in early June has fully reversed into a re-risking stampede. With the Iran deal complete and USD/KRW breaking back below ₩1,500, the FX tailwind is now compounding the equity move for the ~54% foreign float — every won of currency strength adds directly to dollar returns. SK Hynix was bid +6% in pre-market on the peace headline and NVIDIA's strength, then extended through the cash session on the heaviest volume of the recovery. This is the highest-beta vehicle for the global risk-on trade and it behaved exactly as the playbook says: first and hardest to the upside.

what_traders_are_doing: Full risk-on. With Iran risk cleared and the dollar finally retreating, desks are no longer hedging the geopolitical tail — they are positioning for a re-test of the ATH. The supply-side logic is now front-and-center: NVDA up ~2.8% to ~$211 on a Nasdaq +2.38% day is a direct, real-time read-through to SK Hynix HBM demand (watch the /nvidia tape), and traders are buying the supplier as a leveraged play on the same theme. The one note of discipline is FOMC Wednesday: after a +7.4% one-day rip, some are trimming the chase and keeping powder for a possible post-Fed dip rather than pressing into the print. But the dominant posture is unambiguously long.

analysis:
## Peace deal, and the highest-beta name rips

The macro cloud that gutted SK Hynix in early June lifted in a single headline: the [US–Iran peace deal is "now complete" and the Strait of Hormuz is reopening](https://en.bloomingbit.io/feed/news/114282). Global risk-on followed — the Nasdaq rose +2.38% and NVIDIA jumped ~2.8% to ~$211. SK Hynix, [bid more than 6% in pre-market](https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/ueberblick/sk-hynix-jumps-6-percent-in-pre-market-as-geopolitical-hopes-boost-chip/69542239), extended through the cash session to close **+7.4% at ₩2,309,000** — the best day of the recovery and a ~241% year-to-date advance.

This is exactly how the playbook reads: the highest-beta foreign-owned AI-memory name on the KOSPI falls hardest in the panic and rips first when risk clears. With the won breaking back below ₩1,500, the FX tailwind compounded the move for the ~54% foreign float.

## The supply-side twin of the NVIDIA trade

Today made the link explicit. NVDA +2.8% on a +2.38% Nasdaq is not just sympathy — it is a real-time read-through to SK Hynix's order book, because [the company is estimated to hold ~60–70% of NVIDIA's Vera Rubin HBM4 supply](https://stockanalysis.com/quote/krx/000660/) and is the primary advanced-HBM supplier for Blackwell/Rubin. Read this alongside the **/nvidia** page: they are two ends of the same AI-capex pipe, and today both ends fired together.

## Why conviction goes to HIGH

The overhang is gone and the fundamentals are the strongest in company history: [~20% secured HBM3E price hikes for 2026](https://www.trendforce.com/news/2025/12/24/news-samsung-sk-hynix-reportedly-plan-20-hbm3e-price-hike-for-2026-as-nvidia-h200-asic-demand-rises/) to NVIDIA plus Google/AWS ASIC customers, and a [record Q1 — ₩52.6T revenue, +198% YoY, 72% operating margin](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/23/sk-hynix-earnings-ai-memory-shortage-hbm-demand.html). The ~38-analyst PT near ₩2.52M sits ~9% above today's close even after the rip.

## The one discipline

**FOMC Wednesday June 17.** A dovish hold puts the stock into price discovery above the ₩2,407,000 ATH; a hawkish surprise hands you a better add price. After a +7.4% day, hold core longs and scale new adds — don't chase the print into the Fed.
